name: Elanaaga

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Elanaaga is a Telugu poet, translator and paediatrician whose work moves between Telugu and English. His writing includes metrical and experimental poetry as well as literary translation. He received the Sahitya Akademi Translation Prize for 2023 for Ghalib Naati Kaalam, his Telugu translation of Pavan K. Varma’s biography Ghalib: The Man, The Times.

In his Kabita Live poems, moral questions become vivid, sometimes unsettling images. ‘The Awaited Arrival’ addresses impartiality as an absent presence, while ‘Inner Embers’ measures war through the suffering of ordinary people. ‘Quagmire of Confusion’ turns inward, tracing the way anger and distorted perception can unsettle both thought and language.
